title: Superfluous Expressions
theory:
 Superfluous words are unnecessary or extra words used in a sentence that gives the
 same meaning or are not required for grammatically correct expression.
 (Superfluous 'kCn okD; esa fcuk t:jr osQ use fd;s tkrs gS rFkk grammatically vko';

 ugha gksrsA)

The guide instructed the tourists?

mcqs.question: The total cost of the project?
mcqs.explanation: At the place of 'Exceeded more than' only 'exceeded' will be used because Exceed's meaning is only to become more, therefore more than is superfluous

mcqs.explanation: At the place of 'Quite too' only 'too' will be used because Too expresses sufficient degree, therefore quite is considered superfluous -@ n ho
